title: Prismatic Customer
description: A customer represents a company or organization that uses your product and has integrations deployed to them in Prismatic.

externalId.description: External identifier used to map the customer to your own system

avatarUrl.description: URL of the customer avatar image

labels.description: Labels applied to the customer for categorization

allowEmbeddedDesigner.description: Whether the customer is allowed to use the embedded designer

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the customer was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the customer was last updated
